_comment_file: Every failure the core can hand the interface, keyed by the stable `code` on `IpcError` (crates/remoter-ipc/src/error.rs). The code is the join: the core sends a code, a sentence, an optional diagnostic and an ordered list of next actions, and this file supplies the sentence and the actions in the reader's language. A code with no entry here is not broken — the core's own English is rendered instead, which is what a failure newly added in Rust should look like until it is translated. Four rules for anyone editing this file. (1) `actions` is positional: the order is the order the core offered, and a label is used only when the entry has one at that position. (2) No sentence here may quote a password, a passphrase, a key or any other secret — a failure is the one moment an implementation is tempted to say what it was given. (3) The sentences carry no placeholders. The core fills its own sentence with the specifics (a path, a slot number, a byte offset) and those cannot be recovered from the finished string, so each sentence here is written to stay true without them; an English reader is shown the core's own sentence, specifics and all, and every other language is shown this one. (4) A message says what failed and what the reader can do about it. 'An error occurred' is never an acceptable translation of anything below.

unknown._comment_: Not a code the core sends: `asFailure` in apps/desktop/ui/src/lib/ipc.ts uses it when a rejection arrives with no shape at all — a panic inside a command, or a transport failure below Tauri. It is the last sentence in the application and should never be reached.

locked.message: No vault is open. Unlock one to see your connections.

auto-locked.message: The vault locked itself after the idle period you set. Unlock it to carry on.

locked-by-trigger.message: The vault locked itself because an event you chose to lock on happened. Unlock it to carry on.
actions: Change what locks it in vault settings

vault._comment_unlock-failed: SECURITY-CRITICAL. This sentence must not say which factor was wrong, and a translation must not add that either: before a key slot has unwrapped the master key, naming the password or the key file as the wrong one tells an attacker which half they have already guessed. See the module docs in crates/remoter-ipc/src/error.rs.

unlock-failed.message: That did not unlock the vault.
actions: Check the key file, if this vault uses one

header-tampered.message: The header of this vault has been modified since it was written, so its contents cannot be trusted.
actions: Open a backup beside the vault
Check whether a sync client rewrote the file

body-corrupt.message: The contents of this vault could not be decrypted. The file is damaged.
actions: Open a backup beside the vault
Check the drive the vault is stored on

no-such-method.message: This vault does not offer that unlock method.
actions: Choose one of the methods this vault offers

vault._comment_fido2-unsupported: The core sends this code both when a hardware key is offered as a way in and when one is added as a key slot, so the sentence has to stay true of both.

fido2-unsupported.message: Hardware key unlock is not implemented in this version of Remoter.
actions: Use a password or your recovery key

not-a-vault.message: That file is not a Remoter vault.

unsupported-format.message: That vault uses a vault format version this build of Remoter does not read.
actions: Open the vault on the machine that wrote it

corrupt.message: This vault is damaged: its structure could not be read.
actions: Open a backup beside the vault

corrupt-row.message: This vault holds a record this build of Remoter cannot read.
actions: Open a backup beside the vault

header-encode.message: The header for this vault could not be encoded, so it was not written.
actions: Report this — the vault on disk is unchanged

crypto.message: A cryptographic step on this vault failed, so the operation was abandoned.

kdf-too-weak.message: Those Argon2id parameters are below the floor Remoter accepts, and a weaker vault is not an acceptable trade for a faster unlock.

kdf-params-refused.message: This vault declares Argon2id parameters above anything this build will attempt. Nothing was derived.
actions: Open the vault on the machine that wrote it
Open a backup beside the vault

no-such-slot.message: This vault has no such key slot.

no-slot-of-kind.message: This vault has no slot of that kind.

slot-table-full.message: This vault already holds the maximum number of key slots.
actions: Remove an unlock method you no longer use

last-slot.message: That is the only way into this vault; removing it would lock you out permanently.

wrong-slot-kind.message: That key slot is of another kind, so the operation does not apply to it.
actions: Choose a slot of the right kind

slot-credential-missing.message: That key slot cannot be re-wrapped without its password, and dropping it silently would take away someone's way in. Nothing was changed.
actions: Enter the password for that slot
Drop that slot from the rotation deliberately

slot-credential-rejected.message: That does not open the key slot, so the slot was left exactly as it was.
actions: Check the key file, if that slot uses one

keychain.message: This machine's credential store is unavailable, or holds no token for this vault.

recovery-key-malformed.message: That is not a recovery key: a recovery key is fourteen groups of four characters.
actions: Check you pasted the whole key

recovery-key-checksum.message: That recovery key looks mistyped — its check group does not match the rest.
actions: Compare it against the copy you saved

keyfile.message: The key file could not be read.
actions: Check the file is where it was when the vault was created
Mount the drive it lives on

database.message: The database inside this vault rejected the operation.
actions: Open a backup beside the vault

schema-too-new.message: This vault was written by a newer version of Remoter: its schema version is one this build does not understand.

migration-failed.message: This vault could not be migrated to the newer schema; the file was left as it was.
actions: Open a backup beside the vault

invalid._comment_: A bug in the interface, not something the reader did: the frontend sent the core a field it cannot read. Keep the sentence blameless and keep the action pointing at a bug report.
invalid.message: A value in that request is not usable.
actions: Report this — the interface sent something the core cannot read

failed.message: That file could not be read or written.
actions: Check the path exists and is writable

csprng.message: The operating system's random number generator is unavailable, so nothing random can be generated safely.

not-a-private-key.message: That file is not a private key. A public key, a certificate or an unrelated file cannot authenticate a connection.
actions: Choose the private key rather than its .pub companion
Use the platform SSH agent instead

key._comment_unsupported-format: The first action quotes a command. Translate the sentence around it if there is one; never translate the command itself, and keep its flags exactly as they are.

unsupported-format.message: That key is in a format this build does not store. Nothing was written.
actions: Use the platform SSH agent instead

not-a-private-key.message: That item is not a credential holding a private key, so there is no key to read or replace on it.
actions: Choose a key file for it first

purpose-refused.message: This credential is restricted and may not be used this way.

node._comment_not-found: Sent both for an item missing from the vault and for one missing from the tree on screen. Either way the item is gone and the tree on screen is stale, which is what the sentence says.

not-found.message: That item is no longer in the tree; it was probably deleted in another window.

parent-not-found.message: The folder you dropped that into no longer exists.

duplicate.message: An item with that identifier is already in the tree.

not-a-container.message: Only folders can hold other items.
actions: Drop it at the top level

cycle.message: A folder cannot be moved inside itself.
actions: Choose a destination outside that folder

too-deep.message: That move would nest the tree deeper than the limit allows.
actions: Move it nearer the top level

parent-changed.message: An edit cannot re-parent an item; move it instead.
actions: Drag it to the new folder

not-a-connection.message: Only connections have resolved settings to show.

corrupt.message: The item tree in this vault does not terminate: a parent chain loops.
actions: Open a backup beside the vault

not-found.message: That credential has no such secret stored.

stale.message: The stored secret does not match the current version of its record, so it was refused rather than used.
actions: Open a backup beside the vault

too-large.message: That file is larger than this build reads. Nothing was parsed.

not-utf8.message: That file is not UTF-8 text.
actions: Check this is the file you meant to choose

malformed-xml.message: That file is not well-formed XML.
actions: Export the file again from the application that wrote it
Check this is the file you meant to choose

doctype-refused.message: That file carries a document type declaration, which Remoter refuses to process: it is how an XML file is made to read other files on this machine.
actions: Remove the DOCTYPE line and try again
Export the file again from the application that wrote it

entity-refused.message: That file defines its own XML entities, which Remoter refuses to expand: that is the shape of a file written to exhaust memory.
actions: Export the file again from the application that wrote it

too-deep.message: That file nests folders deeper than this build reads.
actions: Flatten the deepest folders in the source application

too-many-items.message: That file holds more items than this build reads.

value-too-long.message: That file holds a value longer than this build reads.
actions: Shorten it in the source application, then export again

truncated.message: That file ends in the middle of a record: the file is incomplete.
actions: Copy the file again from where it came from
Export it again from the application that wrote it

wrong-format.message: That file is not what that importer reads.

password-required.message: That file is encrypted and needs its document password to be read.

wrong-password.message: That is not the password the file was encrypted with.
actions: Check whether the file uses the source application's default password

unsupported-cipher.message: That file is encrypted with a cipher Remoter cannot read.
actions: Export the file again without encryption, then import it
Re-save it from a newer version of the source application

malformed-ciphertext.message: The encrypted part of that file is damaged: it decrypts to nothing usable.
actions: Copy the file again from where it came from
Export it again from the application that wrote it

too-many-nodes.message: That file would create more items than the limit allows.

missing-column.message: That file is missing a column the importer needs.
actions: Add the column header and try again
Check the first row is the header row

duplicate-column.message: That file names a column twice, so which one holds the value is undecidable.
actions: Remove or rename the repeated column

read-failed.message: A file could not be read while following an include.
actions: Check the file exists and is readable
Remove the Include line and import again

include-too-deep.message: That file includes files more deeply than this build follows.
actions: Flatten the Include chain and import again

failed.message: That file could not be imported.

validation._comment_file: The reader's own input being wrong. Each sentence names the rule rather than the value, because the core has already put the value in the sentence it sends and this one has to read correctly without it.

name-too-long.message: That name is longer than the limit.

control-char.message: That value contains control characters, which cannot be stored.

description-too-long.message: That description is longer than the limit.

host-empty.message: This connection has no address. Add a hostname or an IP address.
actions: Enter a hostname or IP address

host-invalid.message: That is not a hostname, an IPv4 address or a bracketed IPv6 address.

port.message: A port has to be between 1 and 65535.
actions: Leave it empty to use the protocol default

tag.message: That is not a usable tag.
actions: Use letters, digits, dashes and dots

protocol.message: That is not a protocol Remoter recognises.
actions: Choose a protocol from the list

setting-key.message: That is not a usable protocol setting name.
actions: Use letters, digits, dashes and dots

custom-field-key.message: That is not a usable custom field name.
actions: Use letters, digits, dashes and dots

validation._comment_colour: The two patterns are syntax, not words: leave #rrggbb and #rrggbbaa exactly as they are in every language.

colour.message: That is not a colour; expected #rrggbb or #rrggbbaa.
actions: Pick a colour from the swatches

icon.message: That icon reference is empty or contains control characters.
actions: Pick an icon from the list

gateway-too-long.message: That gateway chain has more hops than the limit allows.

gateway-cycle.message: The gateway chain loops back on itself: one host appears twice.

gateway-hop-unknown.message: One of the gateway hops points at an item that is no longer in this vault.

gateway-hop-kind.message: A gateway hop has to be a connection; a folder cannot forward traffic.
actions: Choose a connection as the gateway

credential-unknown.message: The credential this uses was deleted. Choose another, or enter one now.

credential-kind.message: That item is not a credential.

credential-attached.message: That credential belongs to another connection. Sharing it would mean editing it in one place changed the other.
actions: Type a username and password here instead

credential-attachment.message: A credential in this vault belongs to a connection that is not there. Nothing was changed.

credential-purpose.message: This credential is restricted and cannot be used for that protocol.

username-too-long.message: That username is longer than the limit.

external-credential.message: An external credential needs both a provider and a reference.

secret-empty.message: A credential needs a secret; an empty envelope is not a credential.

layout.message: A grid layout needs at least one row and one column.
actions: Set rows and columns to 1 or more

group-member.message: One of this group's members is no longer in the vault.

empty-action.message: A connect or disconnect action cannot be an empty line.

reconnect-policy.message: Automatic reconnection needs at least one attempt and a backoff that does not shrink.
actions: Set the maximum backoff at or above the first

interval.message: Timeouts and keep-alive intervals have to be greater than zero.
actions: Clear the field to inherit it
